environment.workspace: same clean task worktree for every retained run

method.mode: two paired elapsed-time baseline runs with order reversal plus one exact-candidate confirmation pair
method.output: each command wrote stdout and stderr to a distinct temporary log; every retained group exited 0
method.warm_cold_mode: fresh child processes per scenario; filesystem caches were not cleared; reversed baseline pair order limits systematic cache-order bias
method.scope_note: Direct manifest-command execution avoids stateful test fixtures deleting the outer qualification report directory during a nested pilot.

threshold.reason: A 10 percent floor separates a useful release-time improvement from ordinary local timing noise while preserving every quality command.

candidate_equivalence.intervening_scheduler_change: critical-cli and full-contract became exclusive, queued qualification work now stops after failure, and provider failures are selected by declared index; the measured successful group contains neither exclusive scenario and exercises no failure path
candidate_equivalence.confirmation: the final exact-candidate pair reran all five measured commands with zero exit codes and exceeded the same threshold

critical_path_control.interpretation: Concurrency does not improve a subset dominated by one critical scenario; critical-cli and full-contract are therefore exclusive scheduler barriers.

excluded_diagnostics.reason: supervisor-frontends is not valid as a partial standalone pilot and produced a blocking audit verdict
stateful fixtures deleted the outer qualification report directory during one nested pilot, so that wrapper-report elapsed data was not used
exploratory concurrency=2 and concurrency=4 runs containing critical-cli showed CPU contention and were used to choose exclusive critical-path barriers, not to claim speedup

verdict.summary: Bounded concurrency reduced median elapsed time by 37.74 percent for the paired baseline, and the final exact-candidate confirmation reduced elapsed time by 33.76 percent with unchanged zero exit codes.
limits: No speedup is claimed for critical-path-dominated groups; critical-cli, full-contract, and timed latency scenarios are exclusive.
Provider throughput remains bounded at three jobs and may be reduced if the release provider throttles.
The v0.7.5 release gate still must run the full 50-run/55-episode provider matrix on the exact integrated candidate SHA.
